catalog.title: Highway portable SIMD library

activation: Use cpg packages paths highway to locate your independent prefix. Include its include directory and link the selected shared or static library.
CMake find_package(hwy CONFIG REQUIRED) exposes the shared installed targets; static archives are also installed for explicit linking.

examples.description: Link a standalone static Highway consumer.
Use find_package(hwy CONFIG REQUIRED) and the hwy::hwy target.
Compile shared/static consumers and check exact arithmetic, unaligned accesses and guard regions for every supported generated target.

notes: The upstream HWY_TEST_STANDALONE mode avoids an implicit GoogleTest download. Fifteen selected upstream test executables must execute every listed case; the rest of the upstream test matrix remains available as source.
Both shared and static libraries and the contributed algorithms are provided. Static upstream test programs are independent of the original build directory.
Do not set a test override to an instruction set unsupported by your CPU. The installed probe enumerates actual supported generated targets before testing each dispatch path.
The profile retains runtime SIMD dispatch. Functional tests and test timings are not official compiler Benchmark scores or physical PMU qualification.
Original material profile and source locks are retained. The ordinary source is unmodified; installed pkg-config prefixes are made relative to their metadata directory.
usage.summary: Highway portable SIMD library with shared/static hwy, contrib and test-support libraries, runtime dispatch and complete source.
